metadata.name: liquid-staking-slash-with-open-queue
metadata.description: Slash-with-open-queue variant of the liquid-staking depeg pressure replay. Withdrawal run fires at tick 3 (ahead of the slash), landing four stakers on the queue with 6_000 units of pending liability. apply_slash at tick 4 shrinks delegated stake by 25% — because the corrected rate formula subtracts pending_unstake_assets, the slash is absorbed entirely by the remaining 2_500 active LST and exchange_rate_bps collapses from 10_000 bps to 2_000 bps (80% depeg). Pins the fixed recompute_exchange_rate in-program: a pre-fix formula that ignored pending_unstake_assets would instead report ~26_000 bps (peg appears to strengthen), and the no_catastrophic_depeg invariant would never fire. Historical inspiration for the depeg geometry: the 2024 Kelp / rsETH depeg.
